scope: Read-only reconciliation of the historical Alabama WAR race/candidate universe (1994-2022) against the current repaired warehouse; no data, code or model output changed.

warehouse.note: data/processed/war/alabama_war_v1/ and data/processed/war/alabama_historical_war_v1/ were not read for content (under concurrent rebuild); only file hashes were taken.

districts_with_no_major_party_candidate_.note: Chamber sizes are 105 house / 35 senate. Districts absent from the compatibility file carry no D/R candidate row at all.
districts_with_no_major_party_candidate_.1998_house_only: 48 of 105 house districts carry no D/R candidate row; the registered SOS precinct source records a single candidate with party_norm='O' in those districts. Whether those contests were unopposed or carry an unlabelled party is not established here.

mart_southern_war_outcome.definition: one row per contest selected by scripts/load_southern_war_preparation_warehouse.py::select_model_outcomes; exactly one D and one R with votes>0, no dontuse/uncont flag, source_etype general

difference_vs_compat_keys_1994_2014.reason: outside the mart's declared 2016-2024 cycle scope, not a defect

canonical_candidates_strict_derivation.method: year/chamber/district groups holding both canonical_party 'D' and 'R'

materialized_canonical_southern_legislat.method: state_code='AL', source_family='alabama_canonical', cycle 1994-2022, groups holding both 'democratic' and 'republican'

identity_check.comparison: cmo_v5_candidates.csv rows vs canonical_candidates on canonical_candidate_id
identity_check.incumbency_vs_warehouse_context_mart: for all 17 the mart_southern_war_context_feature row carries a source_validated incumbent (12 R-held, 5 D-held, strict_incumbency_eligible=1) while canonical_cmo_features.csv records dem_incumbent=0 and rep_incumbent=0

warehouse_lineage_available_not_propagat.per_candidate_precinct_cells: source_southern_legislative_candidate_result observation sets carry precinct cell locators (source_member/source_sheet/source_row/source_column) for 2018/2022

year_2004.note: 2004 is not an Alabama legislative general-election cycle in the 1994-2022 WAR product; the compatibility inputs contain no 2004 rows at all.

source_coverage_gap_2002_house_27.conclusion: A contested D-R race recorded by the registered SOS precinct source (all rows from source member '2002-GeneralElection-PrecinctLevel_0.xls::MARSHALL') has no canonical candidate record and is absent from the 509-race WAR universe. Whether this is an intended coverage exclusion or a canonical identity defect is NOT established by this audit.

out_of_scope_observations: canonical_candidates 2002 house district 26 holds 1,102 D (McDaniel) + 598 R (Patterson) while vote_observations holds two conflicting row sets for the same contest: 77 rows with no source_file (1,102/598) and 50 rows from '2002-GeneralElection-PrecinctLevel_0.xls::MARSHALL' (5,967/3,861). Natural-key duplication adjudication is warehouse-04 scope, not audited here.

2014 house 31, house 66 and senate 30 carry corrupted party labels in vote_observations (e.g. 'Holmes' D 21,532 next to 'Mike Holmes' R 356; 'Chambliss, Jr.' D 4,040 next to 'Chambliss, Jr.' R 16,100). canonical_candidates uses the consolidated official result (10,944 / 7,079 / 22,916) and did not adopt the corrupted rows.

canonical_southern_legislative_candidate_election carries 73 rows of source_family='klarner' for Alabama 1994-2022 across 65 races that do not exist in canonical_candidates; none enters the 97-row Alabama outcome mart.

The repair script scripts/repair_alabama_canonical_certified_totals.py already declares canonical_cmo_candidates.csv, canonical_cmo_features.csv, historical_cmo_extension.csv, alabama_war_v1, alabama_historical_war_v1 and alabama_war_forecast_v1 as stale; this audit quantifies that list rather than discovering it.

conclusions.identity_mismatch_kind: incumbency only, all 2022, all compat=0 vs warehouse=1
conclusions.why: canonical_cmo_features.csv / canonical_cmo_candidates.csv embed pre-certified 2018/2022 totals for 16 races; cmo_v5_races.csv and cmo_v5_candidates.csv inherit them, so the historical WAR output would be scored on superseded D/R totals and stale 2022 incumbency for 17 districts.
regeneration_chain: canonical_candidates is already repaired in place (RUN-4C2EF8D12CC442D99A516E0D393DE157); rerun scripts/build_canonical_cmo_features.py to refresh canonical_cmo_features.csv and canonical_cmo_candidates.csv
regeneration_hazards: Do NOT regenerate canonical_candidates via a full identity rebuild: scripts/repair_alabama_canonical_certified_totals.py records that build_candidate_identity.py would recreate the pre-certified 2018/2022 totals.
rebuild_cmo_candidate_quality_v5.py recomputes direct_cmo and candidate_quality_index, so every v5 consumer (including the ideology page's CQI join) is invalidated, not only the historical WAR.

build_alabama_historical_war_v1.py asserts 509 races and 1018 candidate rows and requires raw_gap == published alabama_war_v1 raw_gap for 2018/2022; a regenerated cmo_v5_races.csv must be rebuilt before, or together with, the modern alabama_war_v1 export.

not_established: Whether the certified-bridge votes are the correct authority for the affected contests (no adjudication performed).
Whether the current data/processed/war/alabama_war_v1/ rebuild carries the certified totals; that directory is under concurrent rebuild and was not read.
Whether the 1994-2014 compatibility totals reconcile to physical source cells; the compatibility inputs carry no source-cell lineage at all.
Whether the 1998 house/senate races with no D/R candidate row (48 house, 7 senate districts) were unopposed or carry an unlabelled party.
Whether the missing 2002 house 27 race is an intended coverage exclusion or a defect.
Whether the 2022 incumbency difference is a compat-input defect or a warehouse-side plan/redistricting reassignment.

Whether election_stage for 1994-2014 compatibility races is 'general' as a matter of source record; the compatibility inputs carry no stage column (the warehouse materialized table records 'general' for all Alabama 1994-2022 rows it holds).
Whether the 546 excluded races are complete: the exclusion ledger is derived from the compatibility files, not from an independent raw-source enumeration of every 1994-2022 legislative contest.
